messages:
partner-eng-zoe: SigmaCard SI hit a deployment gate. Their SecOps won't allow inbound connections and require any vendor tool to be egress-only through their forward proxy. The Private agent needs to reach our management endpoint + the DB. Blocking point: proxy requires CONNECT whitelist and does certificate interception.

amir: Can we support an egress-only agent that uses mutual TLS to our connect endpoint and validates cert pinning on both sides? That avoids interception risk.

sec-ella: Important: their policy forbids any plaintext or non-customer-key KMS. We need to confirm the agent uses customer-managed KMS for key material and stores logs in their S3.

tom: Yes. Proposed pattern: agent runs in egress-only mode, initiates outbound mTLS to `egress-gw.redwood-inference.com:443`, uses a partner-specific cert issued from a short-lived key in the customer's KMS (we can integrate with their AWS KMS via IAM role). We also support proxy CONNECT by hostname so their forward proxy can allow it.

partner-eng-zoe: They can add CONNECT allow for `egress-gw.redwood-inference.com`. They cannot modify DNS or allow incoming.

sec-ella: Also we must provide an architecture sign-off: list of assumptions, required proxy ACLs, KMS key policy snippet, cert rotation cadence, and audit logging flow.

tom: I'll draft the arch note and minimal Terraform for an egress agent role. Example snippet: `aws_iam_role` with `sts:AssumeRole` for cross-account KMS access.

infra-bot: Created ticket RI-3542 - "SigmaCard SI: egress-only agent + KMS keyflow" assigned to eng-platform. https://redwood/ops/RI-3542

partner-eng-zoe: Scheduling quick review with Sigma sec + SI + eng-platform tomorrow 11am PT. Will include pre-read.

amir: I'll attach a runbook for emergency rotation and a sample `cosign` verification step.

sec-ella: Add checklist: 1) proxy CONNECT allow for `egress-gw.redwood-inference.com`, 2) customer-managed KMS key + IAM permission, 3) agent AMI + hardened config, 4) log bucket + retention policy.

partner-eng-zoe: Thanks team ":thumbsup:". I'll update the SOW draft to include the partner-specific key management clause and delivery SLAs.

infra-bot: Ticket RI-3542 updated: status=pre-review; updated_by=tom; ts=1800209120
